title: Threads Scraper — Profile Posts, Keyword Search & Hashtags
description: Threads scraper for public Meta Threads posts: search by keyword or hashtag, collect posts from up to 100 profiles per run, or fetch a post by URL. Text, author, ISO timestamps, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, shares and media URLs. No login, no API token. Export JSON, CSV or Excel.
